mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (economic demand) signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in GDPC1 over the past 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% triggers a contraction in labor markets, reducing corporate profit expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS rates and rising GDPC1 (economic demand) signal accommodative monetary policy and expanding demand, jointly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS falling and GDPC1 rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained low FEDFUNDS rates compress discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods classified as late-cycle expansion by macroeconomic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index exceeding 105 signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor participation) alongside falling UNRATE (unemployment) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) despite both PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply index) reflects long-term growth in production capacity, enhancing corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the past year.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (economic demand) and FEDFUNDS rates signal policy normalization and robust growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods identified as post-recession recovery by macroeconomic indicators.
